counts: 16*(256 train+128 independent mean-validation)+16*32 calibration groups*4+16*64 evaluation groups*4=12288
scope: regular actual G0 PDP-marginal local separation delta=.18 versus .24, no collision q-DQM assertion
teacher_fixed: one predeclared actual phase model and one predeclared control phase model; no test-truth model selection
reference: order12 and order24 evaluate all public candidate/observation pairs; order48 audits predetermined rows and candidates; all failures retained
failure_rule: failed numerical references qualify all dependent claims; no pruning of candidate, group or failure rows
means: candidate means estimated on independent training data, errors checked with independent mean-validation; no exact-mean claim
second_gaussian: diag(diag(tau E[v vH]))+sigma2 I, using actual normalized PDP-marginal covariance and E[s sH]=I
nuisance: unknown common public mu/logtau/lognoise grid for every method; truth used only generation, calibration law design and external scoring
coverage_scope: independent finite-grid split calibration, marginal over calibration and future group; not continuous confidence intervals
